# Third-party licences

<!-- Generated by scripts/licenses/generate-third-party.sh. Do not edit by hand. -->

Payverge is licensed under Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE`); required attributions
are in `NOTICE`. This file lists the third-party components a build of
Payverge ships. Regenerate it with `scripts/licenses/generate-third-party.sh`
after changing `backend/go.mod`, `frontend/package-lock.json`, the bundled
fonts or the override tables. `scripts/licenses/check.sh` enforces the
licence policy; `--check` on the generator fails when this file is stale.

## Go modules (backend image)

Packages linked into `./cmd/app`, `./cmd/email-smoke` and `./cmd/healthcheck`, the
binaries in the backend image, in the default build: no `whatsapp` tag,
`GOOS=linux`, `CGO_ENABLED=0`. Detected with go-licenses v2.0.1. Rows marked `*` use
an override from `scripts/licenses/go-overrides.tsv` (reasons below).

## Frontend npm packages (production dependencies)

Every non-dev entry in `frontend/package-lock.json`, including optional
platform binaries such as the per-OS sharp/libvips and @napi-rs/canvas builds.
A deployment installs only the ones for its own platform. Licences come from
the lockfile, then the installed `package.json`, then
`scripts/licenses/npm-overrides.tsv`.

## Not covered here

- **Container base images.** The frontend runs on `node:26-alpine`, the backend on
  `gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12`. Their OS packages carry their own licences;
  see each image's documentation.
- **`-tags whatsapp` builds.** The opt-in WhatsApp channel links `go.mau.fi/whatsmeow`
  (MPL-2.0) and `go.mau.fi/libsignal` (GPL-3.0). A binary built with that tag is
  GPL-3.0 as a whole. The project does not distribute such builds.
- **Development dependencies** (build, lint and test tooling) are not shipped.
- **Images and other media** are listed in `docs/licensing/CREDITS.md`.
